title: The Double Diamond
author: Design Council
license_observation: The page includes a CC BY 4.0 statement for its Framework for Innovation work. Its exact scope for this separately linked Double Diamond asset is not made explicit in the downloaded image; retained conservatively as unknown pending publication review.
figure: Standalone red Double Diamond graphic linked from Framework for Innovation, all four phase labels and full outlines.
object_count_basis: Four phase labels inside two continuous diamond-shaped process regions. Deliberate small-count exception to the usual 5–30 range.
reading_path: Left to right: Discover then Define in the first expansion/contraction cycle, followed by Develop and Deliver in the second.
merit: Two continuous diamond boundaries encode opening and narrowing choices. The sloped phase labels and directional perimeter arrows make the outline itself explanatory, with almost no incidental decoration.
preview_note: Original transparent PNG retained. Raster preview composites the transparency onto white for the intended page context without changing diagram content.
